sn52.5:1.3: anuruddha, bhikkhunā katame dhammā upasampajja vihātabbāti.
sn52.5:1.4: asekhena āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā.
sn52.5:1.6: idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.5:1.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.5:1.10: asekhena āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbāti.
